improvements.change: PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL + busy_timeout=5000 added on top of WAL.
PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL + busy_timeout=5000 added on top of WAL.

rationale: V4.5.17 only optimized code_graph_storage. V4.5.18 extends the same PRAGMA profile (WAL + NORMAL + busy_timeout=5000) to ccr_store and history_manager, the other two production SQLite connections. The pattern is uniform: WAL keeps the journal append-only, NORMAL defers fsync to checkpoint boundary (still durable on power-loss for committed transactions), and busy_timeout makes concurrent writers queue instead of raising immediately under contention. Expected impact: eliminates the V4.5.16 fail-closed perf gate on cold CI runners, brings every SQLite connection into the same sub-millisecond regime under sustained write pressure.
